steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each requirement is recomputed from the schedule and bill of materials, and each planned order is matched to a requirement.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 part has no bill of materials line

findings.title: Part with no bill of materials line
findings.fix: Add the part to the bill of materials

findings.title: Planned order with no requirement behind it
findings.fix: Remove the order or find its requirement

findings.title: Requirement does not match the recomputed value

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] bom-line-04.md:12  Part with no bill of materials line.
       Fix: Add the part to the bill of materials.
[medium] planned-order-05.md:19  Planned order with no requirement behind it.
       Fix: Remove the order or find its requirement.
[low] req-part-02.md:26  Requirement does not match the recomputed value.
       Fix: Recompute the requirement.
Not checked: Scrap allowances outside the bill.
pros: Checks a requirement that does not match the recomputed value, a part with no bill of materials line, and a planned order with no requirement behind it.
cons: Not checked: Scrap allowances outside the bill.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-mrp-plan skill on the records for this review.
